items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But I met Lee – we used to hang around later, when he was with Nat Cole we traveled a lot, when I was with Sarah.

ctx.x: I don’t remember if I met Lee that time or later. I remember meeting his sister. But I met Lee – we used to hang around later, when he was with Nat Cole we traveled a lot, when I was with Sarah.
How were you received in Frisco and also in Seattle?
